entry.title: Sukuh

buildingCutout.basis: Replace only the five matching Sukuh pyramid/gateway/platform/shrine shells with a two-centimeter numeric tolerance to prevent zero-area native edge slivers. Preserve independent modern buildings, native courtyard ground and water.

terrainReference.basis: Retain original standard6m Mapzen ground/water and independent buildings. Small local level bases have constant buried bottoms sampled along all boundaries. Main pyramid front threshold follows local west grade; its lower body is buried into uphill grade. Gate and detached platforms use separate local floors; short approach steps and narrow retaining edges follow native slope. No broad flattened terrace/island slab or ground/water cutout. Coarse wooded DEM does not resolve exact archaeological terrace/paving/door thresholds; relative and absolute elevations remain approximate.
